title: The range of an injective linear map ℝⁿ → ℝᴾ has an orthonormal frame indexed by Fin n
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let F : ℝⁿ → ℝᴾ be an injective continuous linear map. Then there is an orthonormal family τ = (τ₁, …, τₙ) in ℝᴾ, indexed by Fin n, whose span equals the range of F: span ℝ (range τ) = LinearMap.range (F : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Injective F → ∃ τ : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ τ ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = LinearMap.range (F : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)
